name: Caustic Vent

boost.name: Reclamation
effect: Return a card from your discard pile to your hand.
HIT: Draw 2 cards, then discard a card.

name: Toxic Tendrils
effect: BEFORE: Advance 2. If you moved past the opponent, their attacks do not hit you.

name: Irradiate

boost.name: Launch Sequence
effect: When you reveal your attack, if a copy of your attack is in your gauge or transformation area, it is considered an EX attack.
BEFORE: If the opponent is at range 4 or greater, +2 Power.

name: Ground Zero

boost.name: Power Cycle
effect: When using the "Change Cards" action, you may draw 1 additional card.
HIT: If the opponent is at range 1, +3 Power. Otherwise, Pull 1.

name: Napalm Stream

boost.name: Engineered Destruction
effect: Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Discard any number of them, then put the rest into your hand.
You cannot take more than 5 damage from the opponent's attack.
HIT: Look at the top card of your deck, then you may draw it. If you do not, +2 Power and discard it.

name: Consumption

boost.name: Aftershock
effect: Return a card from your gauge to your hand. If you did, return all copies of that card from your discard pile to your hand.
HIT: Search your deck for up to 3 cards and add them to your hand.

name: Nuclear Option

boost.name: Initiate Launch
effect: Your next attack is considered an EX attack.
AFTER: You may spend 1 Gauge. If you do, return this card to your hand.
If this is an EX attack, this card's gauge cost is reduced to 0.
HIT: Add the top 2 cards of your discard pile to your gauge.
